commits.message:
goal(vm): record three further production defects; fix one stale replay fixture

VM-DEFECT-3 (total break): script-sources stage 7 is unsatisfiable on BOTH
proof paths for even the most trivial state, so the machine can never reach
CEK and NO fraud proof can be completed for any transaction. Unsatisfiability
proven; offending conjunct not yet localized - no production edit until it is.

VM-DEFECT-4/5: two sites reconstruct witness bytes with serialiseData while
every other check requires the canonical definite-length encoding, making
stage-7 successors and stage-1-finish prefixes unsatisfiable. Isolation
probes green; anti-pattern bounded to exactly these two sites.

T1 fixed and parent-verified: script_sources_replay_appends_script_credential_
spend_purposes was a stale fixture (commit 3490a437 migrated replay to
ledger_output_commitment decoding; the hand-written tests kept raw output
CBOR). T2 has the same fix applied but still fails on the script_ref case -
left corrected rather than restored to a provably wrong fixture.
goal(ledger): record the 7f74981f delivery checkpoint to PR #471

merge: reconcile companion-lane recovery hardening (origin 6d0f493b)

Three commits (watcher recovery/admission hardening, review findings,
finalized-rollback recovery). Five conflicts, all resolved as unions with
no fail-closed check dropped from either side:

- state-queue-indexer (5 hunks): kept the companion's digest-based prior
  (verified[priorActiveIndex]) over positional index-1 — the digest lands on
  the same entry whenever orphans exist and additionally proves the link,
  while positional is wrong in the zero-orphan case; widened the rollback
  action list to include rewind_and_replay (required by the new W13
  post-finality recovery and already assumed by the sibling check 40 lines
  above); kept BOTH snapshot predicates (digest-pinned target AND
  still-retained history) since neither subsumes the other; W13 digest
  bindings (nextStoreDigest, rollbackSourceExtends) intact
- three TypeScript import-list conflicts resolved as unions
- GOAL_PROGRESS: ours verbatim plus an attributed remote-session section

Gates: state-queue-indexer 22/22 (was 16, +6 recovery tests), full watcher
package 13/13 files 282/282 (was 242), watcher typecheck clean

goal(ledger): definitive post-fix validation-machine verdict 110/126

- first trustworthy full verdict for the module; all 7 VM-DEFECT-1/2
  controls pass, validating both production fixes
- 16 failures confined to script_sources (11) and CEK (5); every other
  test green; earlier contended sweeps overstated at 22
- contention artifacts identified and excluded (low-load per-test retries)

goal(evidence): rebind artifacts after VM fixes and blueprint regeneration

- capability reconciliation: validation-machine .ak/.ts and watcher
  dependency-map hashes rebound; verifier passes (10 PASS/12 PARTIAL, CG2 open)
- closure manifest: two-pass rebind (the capability artifact's own hash
  changes when its sources rebind); verifier current-tree-valid at 31e1ed9d
  via the GOAL_SPEC 0.2 descent rule; self-test 7/7
goal(ledger): IG1 blueprint regeneration and dependent-pin revalidation
goal(ledger): VM-SCRIPT-SOURCES-CEK row - nine low-load-confirmed latent failures

goal(vm): fix two canonical-V1 validation-machine production defects

VM-DEFECT-2 (soundness): delete the post.ledger_delta_root clearing clause
from rejected_successor_is_exact. It contradicted immutable_context_matches,
which pins that field pre==post, making every rejection one-step unprovable
from any pre-state with a non-empty claimed delta - i.e. from every
adversarial pre-state, since a real invalid transaction always claims one.
The challenger must exhibit a valid rejection successor to win, so the
dishonest operator prevailed by default across all 80 call sites. The
'rejecting terminal derives no operations' duty is discharged elsewhere
(consensus-profile-v1 sec 8; encode_terminal_rejection_witness;
validation-claim-v1 pre/post utxos_root; proof.ak unilateral no-op faults).

VM-DEFECT-1: signatures handoff emitted control result=0 at stage 0 where
the binder requires the -1 'not yet evaluated' sentinel, making no phase-A
step provable after the handoff. TS reference emits -1; an Aiken
transcription slip, fixed at the emitter (not by relaxing the checker).

Controls added (7): a valid transition still cannot be proven rejected;
cleared and rewritten claimed deltas both reject; stage-0 result 0 and 1
both reject; plus positive pairs. Six sites that masked defect 2 by using
an empty claimed delta re-based onto realistic non-empty roots, retaining
one labelled empty case. All 126 original tests preserved (133 total).

Status docs corrected: InvalidOneStepTransition held at PARTIAL pending a
dispute-level regression, coverage-matrix rows and profile field
enumeration annotated. Decision memo: docs/exec-plans/evidence/
vm-defect-decision-memo.md. Compile clean on the merged tree.

goal(vm): normative decision memo for both validation-machine defects

- profile doc 268-271 decisive for defect 2; technical spec silent (recorded
  as such, not inferred); line 2052 is redundant accumulator-era residue
  whose removal restores capability, alternatives rejected with reasons
- severity upgraded to SOUNDNESS break: challenger must exhibit a valid
  rejection successor and cannot for any non-empty claimed delta, so a
  dishonest operator wins by default across 80 call sites
- defect 1 decisive from TS cross-language parity (transcription slip)
- overstated status rows identified for correction
goal(ledger): record two blocking canonical-V1 validation-machine production defects

goal(vm): repair three stale test expectations exposed by the first full module sweep

- canonical_v1_decode_...: fixture used item_count=0; the production
  empty-decode check requires the not-yet-counted sentinel -1 (the other
  five call sites already used -1)
- phase_a_native_scripts_..._exact_no_op and script_sources_rejects_an_
  unsigned_protected_pubkey_output: hand-built terminals omitted
  ledger_delta_root=frontier_commitment(0,[]) required by
  rejected_successor_is_exact; replaced with the exact_rejection_post helper
- all 126 test declarations preserved, zero assertions removed or weakened;
  compile clean
- diagnosis of the remaining failures found TWO PRODUCTION defects, left
  untouched and ledgered for a protocol decision
goal(ledger): VM-MODULE-FAILURES bisect decisive - older latent debt, not merge or C20 damage
goal(ledger): VM-MODULE-FAILURES investigation row (first full 126-test sweep)
goal(ledger): aiken pathology diagnosis, upstream reports 1389/1390/1377-comment
goal(ledger): post-merge battery entry, compiler finding, owner idle-wait rule
